_comment: Ground truth for OWASP crAPI on http://127.0.0.1:8888, confirmed by hand against the running stack on 2026-09-14. Only rows personally reproduced are must_detect:true so recall stays honest. Match key = check|METHOD|path. Two customer accounts (oed_crapi_a@example.com / oed_crapi_b@example.com) were created via POST /identity/api/auth/signup; VIN/pincode emails were read from MailHog GET http://127.0.0.1:8025/api/v2/messages.

expected.note: Confirmed 2026-09-14: user_b GET /identity/api/v2/vehicle/81b3b134-d915-4d36-8fa0-e4ace61b3e9c/location returns user_a's fullName OedCrapiA (and email) with HTTP 200. Vehicle was added with VIN 1CN46GBN95RZZV403 / pincode 5325 from the signup email.

Confirmed 2026-09-14: POST {mechanic_api: http://mailhog:8025/} as user_a returns HTTP 200 with MailHog's HTML title in response_from_mechanic_api. http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/ timed out (no IMDS sidecar in this compose).

Confirmed 2026-09-14: user_a filed report_id=6 via contact_mechanic -> http://crapi-web/workshop/api/mechanic/receive_report with problem_details OEDIPUS_CANARY_crapi_rpt7f3a; user_b GET /workshop/api/mechanic/mechanic_report?report_id=6 returns that canary with HTTP 200. No ownership check.

Confirmed 2026-09-14: an unsigned alg=none token forged from user_a's payload is accepted on GET /identity/api/v2/user/dashboard (HTTP 200, returns OedCrapiA). Tokens are RS256, so the weak-HMAC wordlist does not fire.
